name: Event Registry
tagline: Global news event detection and article search API for media monitoring
description: Event Registry provides a news intelligence API that clusters articles into real-world events, with search, analytics, and media monitoring endpoints. Developers query news content, event timelines, and related articles via a REST API with JSON responses, primarily authenticated by API key. Suitable for news aggregation, trend detection, and automated media research workflows.

auth.details: API key via apiKey query parameter or header; self-serve signup on eventregistry.org

use_cases: search recent news articles by keyword or topic
find events clustered from global news coverage
monitor media mentions of a company or brand
get event timelines and related articles
analyze news trends across languages and sources
